name: aichat
headline: Aichat: All-in-One LLM CLI Tool
short_description: Aichat is a versatile command-line interface tool that integrates various AI capabilities, including Shell Assistant, Chat-REPL, and RAG. With access to multiple AI models like OpenAI and Claude, it helps users to streamline workflows and enhance productivity.
author: sigoden

sections.overview:
Aichat is a command-line interface tool that connects to multiple AI models including OpenAI and Claude, enabling developers and power users to interact with AI directly from their terminal. It combines Shell Assistant functionality for command-line automation, a Chat-REPL for interactive conversations, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) capabilities for enhanced context awareness. The tool streamlines workflows by reducing context switching between applications while providing access to diverse AI models in a unified interface. Users can leverage aichat for code generation, shell scripting assistance, documentation queries, and complex problem-solving without leaving their terminal environment.
Automate customer support responses to improve response times and customer satisfaction.
Generate code snippets on-the-fly to speed up development processes.
Conduct data analysis by querying datasets and generating reports quickly.
Create engaging marketing content tailored to specific audiences using AI.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install sigoden/aichat`
`git clone https://github.com/sigoden/aichat`
sections.usage:
```
Use aichat to streamline your workflow by integrating AI capabilities. For example: 'aichat --model=OpenAI --command="Analyze the sales data for [COMPANY] and identify trends over the past [TIME_PERIOD]. Provide a summary and suggest actionable insights."'. This command leverages OpenAI's models to process and analyze your data efficiently.
```
Copy

```
Based on the sales data for XYZ Corp over the past quarter, several key trends have emerged. Firstly, there has been a 15% increase in sales in the Northern region, driven by a successful marketing campaign. Secondly, the Southern region has seen a decline of 10%, which may be attributed to increased competition. Lastly, the Eastern region has remained stable with a slight 2% growth. To capitalize on these trends, I recommend increasing marketing efforts in the Northern region, conducting a competitive analysis in the Southern region, and maintaining the current strategy in the Eastern region.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
